meaning.en: An accepted member of a group.
meaning.vi: Một thành viên được chấp nhận của một nhóm.

meaning.en: One who has special knowledge or access to confidential information.
meaning.vi: Một người có kiến thức đặc biệt hoặc quyền truy cập vào thông tin bí mật.

meaning.en: A person inside a given place or group.
meaning.vi: Một người trong một địa điểm hoặc một nhóm nhất định.

meaning.en: A person having or likely to have secret or confidential information.
meaning.vi: Một người có hoặc có khả năng có thông tin bí mật hoặc bí mật.

meaning.en: A person who has special knowledge about the inner workings of a group, organization, or institution.
meaning.vi: Một người có kiến thức đặc biệt về hoạt động bên trong của một nhóm, tổ chức hoặc cơ quan.

meaning.en: A person who is within an enclosed space.
meaning.vi: Một người ở trong một không gian kín.

sentences.en: Insider trading statutes target both corporate insider trading statutes target both corporate insiders that breach their duty to shareholders and corporate outsiders that trade on non-public information.

sentences.en: Mr Wolfowitz is one of a small number of people being considered for the US nomination, administration insiders said.

sentences.en: Such systems could be targeted through unauthorized intrusions, DDoS attacks, worms, Trojan horse programs, or malicious insiders.

sentences.en: With debts still high insiders reckon the cost savings a merger would deliver will make the move unavoidable.

sentences.en: The threat is being described by WHO insiders as tantamount to blackmail and worse than any pressure exerted by the tobacco lobby.

sentences.en: Many insiders feel that rare coins are poised to make a comeback in price appreciation due to the highly cyclical nature of the market.

sentences.en: Pennsylvania insiders understand the importance of arriving at the slopes before 10 AM on weekends.

sentences.en: At one point, the controversial star was suspected by industry insiders as being a police informant, and did play one in the movie Caught in the Crossfire.
